Held every four years, the FIBA Women’s Basketball World Cup features the best national teams in the world vying for the gold medal. The U.S. has won gold at four consecutive World Cups and 11 titles overall. The Americans have added one silver and two bronze medals. The FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup 2026 will take place September 2026 in Berlin.
